title: Dwie saszetki na ladzie
description: Detal zakupu: na ladzie są już dokładnie dwie zamknięte saszetki oraz trzy monety. Dłoń Owczara jest już w kadrze i zabiera bliższą saszetkę; druga i monety pozostają. Nie dokładamy sprzedawcy ani kolejnej zapłaty. Montaż 2 s; źródło minimum 3 s.

prompts.image: Use case: sketch-to-render / photorealistic-natural. Create ONE final live-action film still, 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. Input 1 is a WORKING BLENDER RENDER, strictly a camera, spatial layout, scale and composition reference, NOT the final visual style. Input 2 is a SMALL PERSPECTIVE/BLOCKING GUIDE of the same camera: its converging lines explain real spatial directions and its primitive figures mark human placement. Do not reproduce the guide, linework, captions, faceted bodies, plastic surfaces or crude geometry. Rebuild the visible scene as a convincing photographed physical place while retaining the prescribed viewpoint, major dimensions, openings, object positions and framing. Improve natural material variation, construction details, contact shadows and realistic light; do not redesign the layout or invent different architecture. No game-engine look, no illustration, no split panels, no watermark. Early-1990s provincial Polish atmosphere, understated cinematic realism and restrained film grain, no modern products. Input 3 is the exact production identity and wardrobe reference: Dariusz is the chubby red-brown wavy-haired boy with rectangular dark glasses on the LEFT of that reference; Owczar is the slim dark-blond boy in the burgundy track jacket on its RIGHT. Both are 13–14, clean-shaven. Preserve their specific faces, hair, age, body shape and clothing. Owczar has TWO cream stripes on each sleeve, ivory T-shirt, loose blue jeans and worn pale canvas trainers. Dariusz has an open grey-blue plaid overshirt, grey/navy striped T-shirt, dark loose jeans and dark worn trainers. Their positions in the final shot are dictated by the shot instructions, not by the identity reference layout. Replace all visible primitive stand-ins with anatomically natural boys, and insert the boys where requested even if the clean render is empty. No adult beard, no extra people. SHOT ACTION AND COMPOSITION: Close shot of two paper orange-drink sachets and coins on the laminate counter. One teenage hand with burgundy sleeve enters from customer side reaching toward a sachet. Only two sachets. Keep subtle counter wear and readable ORANŻADA W PROSZKU SMAK POMARAŃCZOWY. Soft urban overcast daylight, believable worn materials and subtle dirt without theatrical decay. Keep the same natural atmosphere across the street and shop sequence.  Input 4 specifies only the exact PAPER SACHET artwork and lettering; this is a palm-sized 6 by 9 cm paper packet, not a box. The printed glass is an illustration on the packet, never an actual glass in the scene. Preserve the orange and green print.
prompts.animation: 0.0–1.7s: The burgundy-sleeved hand already reaching across the counter closes thumb and fingertips around the nearer sachet and draws it gently toward the customer, lifting it slightly from the surface. 1.7–3.0s: The hand withdraws toward the lower edge with that same packet. The second sachet and all three existing coins remain still. Camera: locked close-up with focus on the packet and fingers. @Image1 fixes only the existing sachet artwork and lettering. Preserve Start Frame paper scale, sleeve, counter texture and light. No new payment gesture, shopkeeper hand, extra packets, multiplying coins, tearing, spilled powder or cuts.
